releases.title: Tsubomi V2.3 2408 — Starbloom UltraCore
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.3 2408 adds Starbloom UltraCore (burgundy): the Max lineup plus a Scythe, tougher gear, and a full-set passive with a landing shockwave.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Starbloom UltraCore has the lineup of Starbloom Max (the alloy ingot, pickaxe, axe, spade, hoe, lance, helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, shield, bow and arrow) plus the UltraCore Scythe. Durability is 1.25× UltraFast's; the tools mine as fast as UltraFast's and attack is the same as Max's. The pickaxe reaches 9×9.
The UltraCore Alloy Ingot is made from 8 UltraFast Alloy Ingots and a Forest Emblem, giving 8 ingots. The Forest Emblem has a 3% chance to appear in each Woodland Mansion chest.
The UltraCore Scythe is a melee weapon: a mob it kills has a 2% chance to drop its own spawn egg.

Wearing a full Starbloom UltraCore armour set gives passives: fall damage −34%, fire damage −32%, poison damage −18%, lava damage −39%, the Warden's sonic boom −22%, mining speed +2%, movement speed +7%, attack +3%, and a 25% chance that each new harmful effect is shrugged off. Landing from a fall sends a shockwave that deals 37% of the fall damage to hostile mobs within 4 blocks, and magma blocks no longer hurt. Wearing only part of the set gives none of these.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. No other mod is needed; Cherry is optional.
Tsubomi cannot be used together with Alpha. If any Alpha mod is installed the game will not start; remove Alpha's jars first.

releases.title: Tsubomi V2.3 1167 — Starbloom UltraFast
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.3 1167 adds Starbloom UltraFast (light blue): the Ultra lineup plus a Fishing Rod, tools that mine 1.75× as fast as Ultra's, and a stronger full-set passive.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Starbloom UltraFast has the lineup of Starbloom Ultra without the shears (the alloy ingot, pickaxe, axe, spade, hoe, lance, helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, shield, bow and arrow) plus the UltraFast Fishing Rod. Durability and attack are the same as Max's and Ultra's; the tools mine 1.75× as fast as Ultra's, and the pickaxe reaches 9×9 like Ultra's.

The UltraFast Alloy Ingot is made from 8 Ultra Alloy Ingots and an Aomori Emblem, giving 8 ingots. The Aomori Emblem has a 3% chance to appear in each of the Nether chests (Nether fortress, the four Bastion Remnant chests and the ruined portal).
The UltraFast Fishing Rod comes with Lure III and Luck of the Sea III built in and has 160 durability. Only with this rod, each catch has a 0.05% chance of being an Entropy book.

Wearing a full Starbloom UltraFast armour set gives passives: fall damage −31%, fire damage −31%, poison damage −15%, damage from standing on magma blocks −40%, the Warden's sonic boom −13%, mining speed +10%, and an 18% chance that each new harmful effect is shrugged off. Wearing only part of the set gives none of these.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. No other mod is needed; Cherry is optional.
Tsubomi cannot be used together with Alpha. If any Alpha mod is installed the game will not start; remove Alpha's jars first.

releases.title: Tsubomi V2.3 1024 — Starbloom Ultra
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.3 1024 adds Starbloom Ultra (yellow-green), with Ultra Shears and a full-set passive, as the next step after Starbloom Max.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Starbloom Ultra has the lineup of Starbloom Max plus the Ultra Shears, in yellow-green. Durability and attack are the same as Max's, and the Ultra Pickaxe adds 9×9 mining (1×1, 3×3, 5×5, 7×7, 9×9). The Ultra Alloy Ingot is made from 8 Max Alloy Ingots and an Ocean Emblem, giving 8 ingots.

Wearing a full Starbloom Ultra armour set gives passives: fall damage −27%, fire damage −27% and poison damage −10%. The Ultra Shears have a low chance to mine a tall grass as a block; they have 20 uses instead of durability, and a use is counted even when nothing drops. They are not a replacement for vanilla shears (they cannot shear sheep).

sections.title: Warnings

releases.title: Tsubomi V2.3.0.311 — Starbloom Max
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.3.0.311 adds Starbloom Max: the whole Starbloom lineup, stronger, made from a Dragon Egg.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Starbloom Max has the same lineup as Starbloom (the alloy ingot, pickaxe, axe, spade, hoe, lance, helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, shield, bow and arrow). The armour, shield, bow and arrow are 2.5× as strong as Netherite (Starbloom is 1.75×), and the tools are about 1.43× Starbloom's. A full armour set reaches the game's own caps (30 armour, 20 toughness).

The Starbloom Max Pickaxe unlocks 5×5 and 7×7 mining (sneak and use to cycle 1×1, 3×3, 5×5, 7×7); the spade and hoe work a 5×5, and the axe fells bigger trees. It can also mine Budding Amethyst, which then drops as a block.

The Starbloom Max Alloy Ingot is made from one Dragon Egg and 8 Starbloom Alloy Ingots, giving 8 ingots. Because there is only one egg, a Dragon Egg item is also dropped on the exit portal when the Ender Dragon is defeated again and no egg block is there. This rule is covered by tests but has not yet been observed in a real Ender Dragon fight.

In the Creative inventory, the Starbloom and Starbloom Max tools now sit in the vanilla Tools & Utilities tab, the alloy ingots next to the Netherite Ingot in Ingredients, and the Entropy books among the vanilla enchanted books (Entropy I, II and III in a row). They are no longer in the Tsubomi tab; the armour, shields, bows and arrows stay there.

releases.title: Tsubomi V2.3.0.3 — Starbloom armour, shield, bow and arrow
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.3.0.3 adds the Starbloom Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots, Shield, Bow and Arrow, in the vanilla designs recoloured Starbloom pink and gold, and 1.75× as strong as Netherite.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Starbloom armour: the Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings and Boots have the shapes of the vanilla Netherite armour, in Starbloom colours, with 1.75× Netherite's defence, toughness, knockback resistance and durability. A full set reaches the game's own caps (30 armour, 20 toughness).

Starbloom Shield, Bow and Arrow: the shield blocks like a vanilla shield with 1.75× the durability; the bow makes every arrow hit 1.75× as hard (and lasts 1.75× longer); the Starbloom Arrow hits 1.75× as hard from any bow, and a Starbloom Bow with Starbloom Arrows combines both. Four arrows are made from an alloy ingot, a stick and a feather.
A fix for the Starbloom tools: they are now in the vanilla tool tags, so tool enchantments such as Efficiency and Unbreaking can be applied to them.

releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.3.0.2 redraws the Starbloom alloy ingot and tools in the same shapes as the vanilla Diamond tools and the Netherite Ingot, in Starbloom pink and gold.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Starbloom pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and lance now have exactly the shapes of their vanilla Diamond counterparts, recoloured in Starbloom pink with a plum handle, so each one is recognisable at a glance.
The Starbloom Alloy Ingot now has the shape of the vanilla Netherite Ingot, in Starbloom colours. Nothing else changes.

releases.title: Tsubomi V2.3.0.1 — Starbloom tools and carrying animals and villagers
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.3.0.1 brings back the celestial tool set as Starbloom tools, 39% weaker than the originals, and lets you pick up animals and villagers.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Starbloom tools: the lost celestial gear returns in Tsubomi's style. A Starbloom Alloy Ingot (Netherite Ingot, 4 Diamonds and 4 Copper Quartz Ingots) makes a quarry pickaxe that mines 3x3, a felling axe that fells whole trees, a levelling spade, a harvest hoe and a lance that dashes and throws light. Every number is 39% below the original.

Carry animals and villagers: with empty hands, look at one and press G; press G again to put it down. Hostile and large mobs refuse, and you move 15% slower while carrying. Carried mobs take no harm and are put down safely if you leave.

No key clashes: if another mod uses the same default as Tsubomi's Carry or Tool Pouch key, Tsubomi moves its key to a free one by itself, and never touches a key you set yourself. The quarry pickaxe switches its area with Sneak + use, so it needs no key at all.
Light on the server: nothing runs unless a tool or a carry is in use, and the tools break and drop blocks through the game's own rules.

releases.title: Tsubomi V2.3 — the Entropy enchantment
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.3.0 adds Entropy, a treasure enchantment that repairs gear with XP faster than Mending, and a rare Warden drop that carries it.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Entropy, levels I to III: repairs tools, weapons and armour with XP at 1.75, 2.25 and 2.75 times the speed of Mending (3.5, 4.5 and 5.5 durability per XP). Fractions are rounded by chance, so nothing is lost. It cannot share an item with Mending.
A Warden sometimes drops an Entropy book: 12% (3% more per Looting level, 21% at Looting III), as level I, II or III with a 55%, 33% and 12% weighting. You get a message, a sound and sculk particles.
The book is an ordinary Enchanted Book that works in the Anvil and the Grindstone. Books for all three levels are in the Tsubomi creative tab.
Light on the server: it uses the game's own XP repair, with no extra tick and no change to other mods.

releases.title: Tsubomi V2.2.1 — duplicate Nether Star recipe removed
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.2.1 removes a duplicate Nether Star recipe. Only the 3x3 recipe remains.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The duplicate shapeless Nether Star recipe, which used one Diamond and one Ouka Alloy Block, is removed. The 3x3 recipe (4 Diamonds and 2 Ouka Alloy Blocks) is now the only one.
The 3x3 recipe still appears only when OUKA is installed. Nothing else changes.

releases.title: Tsubomi V2.2 — 500 more blocks and a craftable Nether Star
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.2.0 adds 500 building blocks in 50 new material series of 10 shapes, the Emblem of the Ocean, and a recipe that crafts the Nether Star.

sections.title: Highlights
items: 500 new blocks in 50 material series of 10 shapes each: bricks, chiseled, pillar, tiles, lamp, grate, reinforced plating, stairs, slab and wall. The series come in five themes: Japanese architecture, Sengoku metals, cyberpunk facilities, celestial crystals and sacred stones.
Every series is crafted from two plain materials in a 2x2 pattern and cut from its bricks at the stonecutter. Timber series are mined with an axe, the rest with a pickaxe.

Emblem of the Ocean: a new relic that cannot be crafted and is found only in Ocean Monuments. Elder Guardians drop it (15%, more with Looting), Guardians rarely (1.5%), and digging up Wet Sponges or Sea Lanterns underwater sometimes uncovers one (2%).

Craftable Nether Star: the Emblem of the Ocean, a Silence Armor Trim template, a Netherite Ingot, four Diamonds and two Ouka Alloy Blocks, or the five different items together. The recipes appear only when OUKA is installed.
Light on the server: no block has a block entity or a ticker, and the new blocks take no random ticks.

releases.title: Tsubomi V2.1 — Ominous Bottles, level 6 to 13
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.1.0 adds eight Ominous Bottles (levels 6 to 13) that raise your Bad Omen level and make ominous vault rewards better the higher you go, up to a guaranteed Heavy Core.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Eight Ominous Bottles, levels 6 to 13. Drinking one gives Bad Omen at that level. Each bottle glints, and its tooltip shows the Heavy Core rate and the reward multiplier.
Better ominous vault rewards at every level: the Heavy Core chance rises from 18% to a guaranteed one at level 13, 1 to 6 bonus loot rolls, and rewards that only that level gives.
Or offer a bottle directly: sneak and use it on a Spawner, a Vault or an Ouka Alloy Block to get the reward at once.
Each bottle is crafted from the one below it with Nether Stars. Levels 10 and 13 need OUKA's Ouka Alloy Block, so those two recipes appear only when OUKA is installed.

releases.title: Tsubomi V2 — 200 new blocks, the Enchanted Apple, a craftable spawner
releases.summary: Tsubomi V2.0.0 adds 200 building blocks in 20 material series of 10 shapes, the Enchanted Apple, a craftable Monster Spawner and a recipe for every Spawn Egg.

sections.title: Highlights
items: 200 new blocks in 20 material series of 10 shapes each: bricks, chiseled, pillar, tiles, lamp, grate, reinforced plating, stairs, slab and wall. Every series is crafted from a plain material and can be cut from its bricks at the stonecutter.
Enchanted Apple: an apple and a Nether Star. Eating it heals every player online at once and gives them Regeneration II and Speed II.
Craftable Monster Spawner: amethyst shards, tall grass, Nether Stars, an Enchanted Apple and OUKA's Ouka Alloy Block. The recipe appears only when OUKA is installed.
A Spawn Egg recipe for all 88 mobs: a Nether Star (more for the stronger mobs) plus items that suit the mob.
Light on the server: no block has a block entity or a ticker, and the new blocks take no random ticks. The Enchanted Apple acts once, when it is eaten.

releases.title: Tsubomi V1.1 — 100 new blocks
releases.summary: Tsubomi V1.1 adds 100 new building blocks in 5 families of 20: sakura crystal, spiritwood, porcelain, clockwork and shrine.

sections.title: Highlights
items: 100 new blocks in 5 families of 20: crystal and amber, spiritwood and crimson bamboo, porcelain and jadeite, clockwork and brass, shrine and ritual. Every block can be crafted.
Sakura crystal: a budding crystal grows buds that ripen from small to medium to large to a cluster; the crystal lamp lights with redstone; the resonating core rings once each time it is powered.
Spiritwood is a set that does not burn, with stairs, slab, fence, gate, door, trapdoor, pressure plate and button, and an axe strips it. Crimson bamboo burns like bamboo.
Clockwork: copper casings weather like copper, pipes join each other, the pressure gauge reports the strongest redstone signal to a comparator, and the clockwork door and trapdoor open by hand.

Shrine: lanterns, a bell that rings far away, hallowed soil that speeds up the plant above it, an almost silent carpet, a loom that opens a crafting grid, a respawn anchor, and a chronometer whose signal follows the day and the moon.

Light on the server: no block has a block entity or a ticker. Only the budding crystal, the leaves, the copper casings and the hallowed soil take random ticks, and only while they grow, decay or weather.

releases.title: Tsubomi V1.0.1 — the Teleport Elevator returns
releases.summary: Tsubomi V1.0.1 brings back the teleport elevator as a Tsubomi block: stack elevators in a column, jump to go up, sneak to go down.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Teleport Elevator (new block): place two or more in a column; jump on one to rise to the next above, sneak on one to drop to the next below, up to 64 blocks away.
Recipe: 6 copper quartz ingots, 1 ender pearl and 1 redstone make 2 elevators.
Light on the server: the elevator is a plain block with no block entity and no ticker, it costs nothing while nobody rides it; a blocked destination stops the trip, and spectators are not carried.

releases.title: The Vernal Genesis: Refined Essentials for Every Journey — Tsubomi's first release
releases.summary: Tsubomi's first release: a smart wooden crate that keeps its contents, a gravity chute, a tabletop bonsai, herbal tea, a tool pouch, a brass hand lantern and copper quartz tools — and nothing heavy: not one block ticks all the time.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Wooden Smart Crate: 36 slots, and it keeps its contents when you break it and carry it. It opens and closes like a barrel and a comparator can read it. A crate cannot go inside a crate, and if the item is destroyed by fire, lava or an explosion its contents spill instead of vanishing.

Gravity Mini Chute: stack up to 128 in a column and whatever goes in at the top arrives at the bottom at once. It takes items from hoppers, droppers and item entities that fall in, hands them to a container below, or drops them if nothing is there. It has no block entity and never ticks.
Bonsai Pot: plant an oak or cherry sapling and it grows in stages, then now and then gives up a few leaves, petals or tree sap (4 tree sap make a slime ball).

Herbal Tea: dry leaves or petals over a campfire into tea leaves, then combine them with a water bottle. It gives Speed I for 45 seconds and a lingering aroma of Jump Boost I for 30 seconds, and leaves an empty bottle.

Adventurer's Tool Pouch: holds up to 9 stacks of torches, pickaxes and shovels. Press V (rebindable) to trade your selected hotbar slot with the pouch, round and round, with a short 3-tick cooldown; in the inventory it works like a bundle.
Brass Hand Lantern: hold it in your off-hand and a soft light of level 12 follows your eyes. It leaves no light behind.

Copper quartz: 2 copper ingots and 1 quartz make 2 copper quartz ingots, for a pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword with 640 durability, mining speed 6.5 and iron's mining level, repaired with the ingot.

With Cherry installed, copper quartz stands in for iron in Cherry's thermal lining and propellant canister recipes (a data pack, on by default and switchable in the data pack screen). Cherry's own recipes still work.
Nothing heavy: 1,024 crates and 1,024 chutes standing still add nothing to a tick, and carrying through 1,024 of them costs about one hundredth of the same carrying with vanilla hoppers.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. No other mod is needed; Cherry is optional.
Tsubomi cannot be used together with Alpha. If any Alpha mod is installed the game will not start; remove Alpha's jars first.
The pouch key (V) works when Tsubomi is also installed on your client; on a server-only install, use the pouch by clicking in the inventory.
